instruction: Add a Pantone spot color channel to my image using GIMP.

metadata.explanation: GIMP does not support Pantone spot color channels, which are used in professional printing workflows to ensure precise color reproduction. While GIMP can work with RGB channels and layer masks, it cannot create or manage spot color channels that are essential for offset printing and brand color consistency. This makes the task infeasible in GIMP.
metadata.infeasible_reason: GIMP lacks Pantone spot color channel support
